name: fac-manager-check-in-guide
description: Builds the guide a manager uses around a programme, with the before and after conversations in the manager's own words, check-ins placed in meetings that already exist and a barrier log of conditions. Use for "run fac-manager-check-in-guide", "manager check-in after training", "manager conversation guide", "post-training conversation", "training transfer with managers", "how managers support training", "barriers to applying training", "the manager never asks what they learned", part of the Claude for Trainers and Facilitators Pack by 90n.
